title: fix(metadata-protocol): move findData into its facet; host-split refuses a method read as a value, so getDiscovery stays
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEaLDouphrUMvBWbK52b3uh)_

Fixes #30518
Refs #30054
Refs #30147

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:用 `--members` 把 `findData` 的方法体搬进 `ProtocolDataCrudFacet`,删掉它的门面例外登记;`host-split.mjs` 新增一条规则：实例方法若不是被调用、而是当作值读取，就拒绝搬移;`getDiscovery` 因此留在类上，登记行改挂 #30147。
- 为什么改:首版也搬了 `getDiscovery`,但它用 `typeof this.searchAll === 'function'` 算出 `capabilities.search`;搬走后宿主条目是一个转发闭包，永远是函数，于是不能搜索的协议也会宣称可以搜索(rest 的 `discovery-search-capability-agreement.test.ts` 抓到)。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移加一条拒搬规则，方法体逐字节不变，公开 `index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` 前后字节相等;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`host-split.mjs` 新增的 4 行与 `host-split.test.mjs` 的两个用例;`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` 的 getDiscovery 行;`protocol.query-transport-dialect.test.ts` 的 4 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base b6182249`,预期 `1 moved method(s) (findData)`、退出码 0;`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members getDiscovery` 预期退出码 2,理由为 `instance method \`searchAll\` read as a value`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The move.** `findData` (751 body lines) now delegates in one line to `ProtocolDataCrudFacet`; its signature and docblock stay on the class. `protocol-host.ts` gains the eight entries its body reads (`searchAll` and seven `assert*` field guards). `protocol.ts` goes from 13,775 to 13,007 lines and drops 28 import bindings only the moved body read. Written by `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members findData --write`, no hand edit after it. Its registry row leaves.

**The rule.** `host-split.mjs` refuses an instance method read other than as a callee (`typeof this.m`, `const f = this.m`): a host entry forwards a method through a closure, which is always a function, so the moved read would see the closure, not the instance's member. This mirrors the rule it already had for a private static method read as a value. `host-split.test.mjs` gains two refusal cases (the `getDiscovery` probe shape and a plain value read); both fail without the rule. Over the first pass's own `--verify --base 48914fdc^`, the rule changes exactly one member's verdict, `getDiscovery`.

**`getDiscovery` stays.** Its body sets `capabilities.search` from `typeof this.searchAll === 'function'` (#7541). The first version of this PR moved it, and `packages/rest` `discovery-search-capability-agreement.test.ts` went red (2 of 4): a protocol that shadows `searchAll` with `undefined` advertised search while `/search` answered 501. Its row returns to `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` under #30147 (the codemod-limit rows card), with that reason; the `liveness/qa.json` citation stays on `protocol.ts#getDiscovery`.

**The path reader.** `protocol.query-transport-dialect.test.ts` ("the fold names the spec export at the call site") read `protocol.ts` by path for `findData`'s call site; it now reads `protocol.ts` and `protocol-data-crud.ts` joined.

**The citations** that moved with the body: `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/search.json` (`protocol.ts#findData` -> `protocol-data-crud.ts#findData`), and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json` (`protocol.ts#UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM` -> `protocol-data-crud.ts#UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM`, a string token inside `findData`'s body that `check-platform-checklist.mjs` reported as ABSENT SYMBOL).

## Why

#30054 spelled the eight doors' return types (PR #30516) so their bodies could leave the facade; #30518 asked for the pass that moves them. PR #30687 added the pass and moved six; this PR moves `findData` and closes #30518 with `getDiscovery` a named codemod-limit exception carried by #30147.

- `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --self-test`: 85 cases in 10 batteries pass. `host-split.test.mjs`: 40 pass; 2 fail with the rule removed (negative control).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` at `0df9bd1d`: vitest 320 files passed, 4 skipped; 22,487 tests passed, 26 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `packages/rest` `discovery-search-capability-agreement.test.ts`: 4/4 at `0df9bd1d` (2/4 at `946d40b7`). Full `packages/rest` locally: 12 failures, all `_migrate-record-currency-codes` rows of `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`, the same 12 with this PR's `src` reverted (a local build artifact of #30809's packages; CI's verdict on the new head decides).
- `check:liveness` exit 0 and its tests (359) pass; `check:platform-checklist` exit 0; `check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` exit 0 (46 named exceptions).
